hardGateFindings.finding: External-reader and hiring actions remain planned and explicitly unmeasured; no recruiter comprehension, collaborator agreement, application, interview, or hiring outcome is claimed.

Eight distinct controls specify signal, state, owner, trigger, test, rule, and evidence return, with digest-bound receipts, mandatory Fair Rent follow-up, bounded inquiries, full-population reviews, render-derived route governance, and mosaic review.
The distinct read-only session provenance is disclosed as auditable but not cryptographic, and the evaluation is accurately bounded as an LLM control evaluation rather than human validation.

The packet preserves bounded public-proof and canonical-role ledgers, mixed and first-person attribution, mosaic review exclusions, contained non-symlink paths, and explicit exclusions for relationship graphs and private feedback.

limitations: This judgment evaluates the stated frozen control packet and its governance design; it is not independent human validation of portfolio claims or usability.
External-reader and hiring actions are planned but unmeasured, so recruiter comprehension, collaborator agreement, applications, interviews, and hiring outcomes remain not-yet-measured.
Session separation and read-only provenance are auditable disclosures, not cryptographic proof of evaluator independence.
The current mosaic review excludes relationship graphs and private feedback, so those inputs have not been assessed for additive privacy risk.
